description: This file defines the VoicemailFilterFactory class, which provides factory methods to create VoicemailFilter objects for various filtering criteria in an Android voicemail application. It includes methods to create filters based on where clauses, matching voicemail fields, read status, and to combine filters with logical AND/OR operations.

classes.name: VoicemailFilterFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing static methods to create VoicemailFilter objects based on various criteria.

methods.name: createWithWhereClause
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailFilter with a specified SQL where clause. Use only if you know the exact column names.

methods.name: createWithMatchingFields
methods.description: Creates a filter matching the fields set in a given Voicemail object.

methods.name: createWithReadStatus
methods.description: Creates a filter matching voicemail read/unread status.
